interface.signature: def eventualSafeNodes(V: int, adj: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]

preconditions.expression: 0 < V <= 10**4 and all(0 <= u < V for neighbors in adj for u in neighbors)
preconditions.description: V is a positive integer in [1, 10^4], and all nodes in adjacency lists are valid vertex indices in [0, V-1].

preconditions.expression: all(len(neighbors) == 0 or all(u != v for u in neighbors) for v, neighbors in enumerate(adj))
preconditions.description: The graph has no self-loops (no edge from a node to itself).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V for u in range(V))
preconditions.description: All vertices are distinct integers in the range [0, V-1].

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for v in range(V) if all(not any(cycle_detected(v, u) for u in neighbors) for neighbors in [adj[v]]))
postconditions.description: The returned list contains exactly those nodes `v` for which every possible path starting at `v` eventually reaches a terminal node (a node with no outgoing edges).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= v < V for v in return_value)
postconditions.description: All nodes in the returned list are valid vertex indices in [0, V-1].
The returned list is sorted in ascending order.
